EC1: Documented positive hepatitis B (HBV) surface antigen [OR] , and/or HBV DNA prior to enrollment
EC2: Any prior exposure to HCV protease inhibitor therapy
EC3: HIV co-infection [AND] if on a protease inhibitor based regimen
EC4: Increase in creatinine of 15% or greater within one month (30 days) of the screening visit
EC5: Evidence of hepatocellular carcinoma at the time of enrollment
EC6: Liver disease caused by an etiology [NOT] other than HCV
EC8: Child Pugh class B or C
EC9: AST [OR] or ALT >350 within 6 months prior to enrollment
EC10: Albumin < 3g/dL at the time of enrollment
EC11: Platelet count < 75 at the time of enrollment
EC12: History of clinically significant allergy [OR] or adverse event [AND] with protease inhibitors
EC13: Evidence of the acquisition of HCV at the time of or after transplantation
EC15: Cyclosporine [OR]; St. John's Wort [OR]; Efavirenz [OR]; Phenytoin [OR]; Carbamazepine [OR]; Bosentan [OR]; HIV protease inhibitors [OR]; modafinil [OR]; ketoconazole [OR]; or rifampin use within 7 days of enrollment
EC16: Coadministration of more than 20 mg atorvastatin [OR]; 10 mg rosuvastatin [OR]; 20 mg of fluvastatin [OR], lovastatin [OR] or simvastatin
